description: SEC insurer underwriting metrics — Insurance company scorecard from SEC 10-K XBRL: earned premiums and growth, loss ratio, all-in cost to premiums (a consolidated combined-ratio proxy), investment yield, ROE and net income for up to 5 years, with trend and flags. Verdict STRONG_UNDERWRITING_PROFIT / UNDERWRITING_PROFIT / MARGINAL / UNDERWRITING_LOSS / HEAVY_UNDERWRITING_LOSS (best for property and casualty insurers). Param ticker (or CIK), e.g. TRV, CB, PGR, ALL. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
